WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT visit_occurrence_id
  FROM omop.measurement
  WHERE visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL
    AND measurement_concept_id IN (4015482,3051714,3048530,4322628,2212698,42709958)
), img AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT visit_occurrence_id
  FROM omop.procedure_occurrence
  WHERE visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL
    AND procedure_concept_id IN (3526066,3568910,36713226,42742555,2212002,2212003,2212004,2212007,3038858,3035871,3037092,40338992,4175357,44798684,3529915,3040857)
), suspected AS (
  SELECT visit_occurrence_id FROM d
  UNION
  SELECT visit_occurrence_id FROM img
), d_by_visit AS (
  SELECT visit_occurrence_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN measurement_concept_id IN (4015482,3051714,3048530,4322628,2212698,42709958) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_ordered,
         MAX(CASE
           WHEN measurement_concept_id = 42709958 THEN 1
           WHEN value_as_number IS NULL THEN NULL
           WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(unit_source_value,'')) LIKE '%NG/ML%' AND value_as_number >= 500 THEN 1
           WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(unit_source_value,'')) LIKE '%UG/ML%' AND value_as_number >= 0.5 THEN 1
           WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(unit_source_value,'')) LIKE '%MCG/ML%' AND value_as_number >= 0.5 THEN 1
           WHEN value_as_number >= 500 THEN 1
           ELSE 0 END) AS d_positive,
         MAX(CASE WHEN value_as_number IS NOT NULL OR measurement_concept_id=42709958 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_interpretable
  FROM omop.measurement
  WHERE visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL
    AND measurement_concept_id IN (4015482,3051714,3048530,4322628,2212698,42709958)
  GROUP BY visit_occurrence_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS suspected_encounters,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_dimer_ordered_encounters,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_d_dimer_ordered,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_interpretable=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_dimer_interpretable_encounters,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_positive=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_dimer_positive_encounters,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d_positive=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d_interpretable=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_positive_among_interpretable,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d_positive=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_positive_among_ordered
FROM suspected s
LEFT JOIN d_by_visit d ON d.visit_occurrence_id=s.visit_occurrence_id;

WITH suspected AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT visit_occurrence_id, person_id, measurement_date AS index_date
  FROM omop.measurement
  WHERE visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL
    AND measurement_concept_id IN (4015482,3051714,3048530,4322628,2212698,42709958)

  SELECT DISTINCT visit_occurrence_id, person_id, procedure_date AS index_date

), per_visit AS (
  SELECT visit_occurrence_id, person_id, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
  FROM suspected
  GROUP BY visit_occurrence_id, person_id
), outcome AS (
  SELECT s.visit_occurrence_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN co.condition_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pe_7d
  FROM per_visit s
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id=s.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN s.index_date AND DATEADD(day,7,s.index_date)
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (440417,45768439,43530605,40479606,608954,4120091,4108681,4236271)
  GROUP BY s.visit_occurrence_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS suspected_encounters,
       SUM(pe_7d) AS confirmed_pe_7d,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(pe_7d)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(6,2)) AS pct_confirmed_pe_7d

I could answer the D-dimer part from structured OMOP data, but the PE-within-7-days cluster analysis is blocked by repeated MedCP SQL timeouts on the required joins/text/NLP scans.

## Cohort definition used

“Suspected PE encounter” was approximated as any encounter with either:

- a D-dimer measurement/order concept, or
- PE-directed imaging/procedure codes such as CT pulmonary angiography or V/Q scan.

## D-dimer ordering and positivity

Among suspected PE encounters:

| Suspected PE encounters | 89,917 |
| Encounters with D-dimer ordered | 84,169 |
| D-dimer ordered rate | 93.61% |
| Encounters with interpretable D-dimer result | 38,754 |
